name: Goliath
overview: The biblical account of Goliath and his descendants highlights the ongoing conflict between Israel and the Philistines, where Goliath himself defied the armies of Israel and was ultimately slain by David (2 Samuel 21:15-17). The narrative also reveals that Goliath's sons and other giants continued to challenge Israel, engaging in fierce battles where notable warriors of Israel overcame them (2 Samuel 21:18-20). These passages emphasize God's deliverance of His people through chosen instruments like David and his men, preserving the 'light of Israel' amid persistent threats.
